⣾⣽⣻⢿⡿⣟The generated client never declares its events, so no collection is ever live FLYBYME/surfdns#57
Open • FLYBYME (Tim) opened about 13 minutes ago • 0 comments


  mesh-web 0.15.10 can stream a collection:  ApiSpec.events ,                 
  isCollectionStreamed , and the                                              
   ${name}.created|updated|deleted  handling all landed with FLYBYME/mesh-    
  web#4. The server half has                                                  
  existed for longer —  /events  is a real SSE endpoint (                     
  src/api/methods/stream.ts ), it re-resolves                                 
  the caller on every heartbeat, and  decideDelivery  narrows each payload per
  subscriber.                                                                 
                                                                              
  Nothing connects them.  src/api/methods/client.ts  emits  defineApi({ ... })
  with  calls  and a                                                          
   shapeHash  and no  events  key at all, so  isCollectionStreamed  answers   
  false  for every                                                            
  collection in every console. Every list in the platform is therefore a      
  static snapshot with a                                                      
  refresh button beside it, which is the actual complaint:                    
                                                                              
  │ there should be no refresh button right? it should just be automatic?     
                                                                              
  ## What to do                                                               
                                                                              
  The generator emits  events  for each exposed CRUD collection, derived the  
  same way the exposure is                                                    
  — from the site record and the event table ( src/api/methods/events.ts ),   
  never hand-listed. A                                                        
  collection the site does not expose must not appear, and an event the       
  subscriber's scope cannot be                                                
  narrowed to must not be declared as if it will arrive.                      
                                                                              
  Then verify it end to end against a real node: open the console, change a   
  row from another client,                                                    
  and watch the list move without a fetch.                                    
                                                                              
  ## Not in scope                                                             
                                                                              
  • The shapeHash's contents (separate problem, being changed in the catalog  
  work)                                                                       
  • Anything in  mesh-core                                                    


View this issue on GitHub: https://github.com/FLYBYME/surfdns/issues/57
